title: Verdant Harvest
description: This Mod adds various of Crops and Foods
body:
# Verdant Harvest Mod Introduction
## Basic Information
- Mod Name: Verdant Harvest
- Development Framework: Fabric API
- Mod Positioning: Light vanilla-style agricultural expansion mod, focusing on a complete corn farming and food processing system. All art resources follow Minecraft original pixel style, retaining vanilla game logic without redundant complex mechanisms.

#### Verdant Harvest Food
- Corn: Raw corn cob, edible directly
- Roasted Corn: Furnace-baked corn cob with higher hunger saturation
- Popcorn: Unique puffed food crafted with corn kernels

## Gameplay Highlights
1. Lightweight Design
Only expands the corn industrial chain, no redundant machinery or messy extra crops. Ideal for players who want mild farm content enrichment.

2. Native Vanilla Compatibility
Reuses vanilla farmland, light requirement and crop growth rules, bringing natural and smooth survival experience.

3. Full Production Chain
Complete gameplay loop: Sow corn → Harvest corn cobs → Extract corn kernels → Make roasted corn or popcorn. Enrich early-game food choices beyond wheat, carrots and potatoes.

4. Cross-Loader Support
Only Bedrock and Fabric Loader we support currently.
